displayName: GHADV-3131: XWiki Platform has path traversal via resources parameter in ssx and jsx endpoints when using leading slash
description:
XWiki Platform has path traversal via resources parameter in ssx and jsx endpoints when using leading slash

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: xwiki platform has path traversal via resources pa

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_other_ghadv_3131", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%xwiki%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%platform%') AND "value" > 0
